appauth: Secure Authentication and User Management for Shiny

Source: R/appauth-package.R
appauth-package.Rd

The package combines what must be the same in every Shiny application: password storage as hashes, brute-force protection, blocking and deletion of users, auto sign-in tokens, server-side permission checks and versioned migrations of the database schema (SQLite, DuckDB, MySQL / MariaDB, PostgreSQL). Everything that differs from application to application (the matrix of roles and permissions, log switches, the contents of the access tab) stays with the application and is attached through extension points.

Details

See the architecture-and-security vignette for details on the design and the threat model.
